parameters.jsonBody:
={{
JSON.stringify({
  eik: $json.eik,
  business_name_bg: $json.business_name,
  business_name_en: $json.business_name,
  legal_form_bg: $json.legal_form_bg,
  business_structure_en: $json.business_structure_en,
  entity_type: $json.entity_type,
  current_owner_name: $json.representative,
  phone_number: $json.phone,
  vat_number: $json.vat_number,
  source: $json.source,
  profile_status: $json.is_eligible ? 'verified' : 'needs_manual_review',
  wallester_status: $json.wallester_status,
  wallester_account_id: $json.application_id,
  wallester_registration_started_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  wallester_registration_completed_at: $json.is_eligible ? new Date().toISOString() : null,
  is_active: true
})
}}

parameters.responseBody:
={{
JSON.stringify({
  ok: $json.is_eligible,
  application_id: $json.application_id,
  status: $json.eligibility_status,
  company_name: $json.business_name,
  eik: $json.eik,
  vat_number: $json.vat_number,
  representative: $json.representative,
  card_tier: $json.card_tier,
  bonus_amount_eur: $json.bonus_amount_eur,
  onboarding_url: $json.onboarding_url,
  source: $json.source,
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  message: $json.is_eligible 
    ? "Business profile verified and successfully approved for Wallester Business Card with up to 150 EUR bonus." 
    : "Submission received and queued for manual compliance review."
})
}}
